title: Small Compiler Subset Emits BSharp IR Under Ruby Referee
purpose: Emit deterministic BSharp IR from the small compiler subset parser through the independent SmallCompilerSubsetSemanticResolver while the existing Ruby Parser plus SemanticResolver remain the separate production authority and referee.

allowed: adding compiler/small_compiler_subset_ir_emitter.rb as a non-production BSharp IR emission experiment
emitting BSharp IR from SmallCompilerSubsetParser output for sealed subset fixtures
comparing the subset-emitted BSharp IR against the existing Ruby Parser plus SemanticResolver referee
recording deterministic IR emitter records for future self-hosting work
preserving existing runtime, BSharp Bytecode, Save, ASK, input devices, web, and browser behavior
resolving the subset AST through compiler/small_compiler_subset_semantic_resolver.rb before BSharp IR emission
forbidden_until_later_approval: replacing compiler/parser.rb as the production parser authority
changing runtime meaning, BSharp Bytecode, Save format, ASK output, input devices, graphics, engine bridge, browser work, web export, or Ruby retirement

output_schema.parser_ruby_referee_matches: true only when SmallCompilerSubsetParser matches Ruby Parser statement structure
output_schema.ruby_referee_matches: true only when emitted BSharp IR matches Ruby Parser plus SemanticResolver output
output_schema.bsharp_ir: resolved BSharp IR document compatible with bsir.debug.json

acceptance_rules: The small compiler subset IR emitter tool must pass in the Trial-by-Fire validation inventory.
compiler/small_compiler_subset_ir_emitter.rb must emit from SmallCompilerSubsetParser records, not replace normal compilation.
Subset-emitted BSharp IR must match the existing Ruby Parser plus SemanticResolver referee for accepted fixtures.
The new IR emitter must not become the production compiler path in this build.
No Profile 8, syntax, runtime, bytecode, web export, browser, engine bridge, or Ruby retirement work is allowed.
The primary subset BSharp IR document must be resolved by SmallCompilerSubsetSemanticResolver; production SemanticResolver is referee-only.
